description: Pony-based SDXL merge (confetti/pony/DPO variants) using the full score_9..score_4_up + source_anime quality-tag convention. Understands both danbooru- and e621-style tags (also supports source_cartoon/source_furry/source_pony as style switches), so tag_dictionary is left unset to search/check both. The creator advises against complex/'schizo' negative prompts, so the negative here is deliberately short. Common community-recommended starting point, not tuned against a specific install.
positive_prompt_prefix: score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up, source_anime
negative_prompt_prefix: score_6, score_5, score_4, worst quality, low quality
